findings.title: Datetime audit-log ordering fails in the optimized paginator
findings.body: The audit-log endpoint passes `order_by="-datetime"` to this paginator, but `datetime` fields cannot be passed to `math.floor` or `math.ceil`. On any non-empty optimized page, cursor construction calls `get_item_key` and raises `TypeError`, so authorized requests with `optimized_pagination=true` fail instead of returning results. This paginator needs datetime-aware key conversion, like `DateTimePaginator`.

findings.title: Negative offsets cause Django queryset slicing to raise
findings.body: When advanced pagination is enabled and a cursor has a negative offset, this code passes that offset directly to a Django `QuerySet` slice. Django does not support negative queryset indices and raises an exception rather than interpreting them as reverse pagination, so a negative cursor sent to the optimized endpoint produces a server error. Use a supported query strategy or reject negative offsets.
